title: INDEX 38 — Watch macro photography and reflection control, 6 deliverables

config.text:
# INDEX 38

## Project
- Series name: INDEX 38
- Subject: one hand-wound wristwatch
- Audience: watch editors and collectors
- Feature: watch macro photography and reflection control

## Watch dimensions
| Measurement | Value |
|---|---|
| Case diameter excluding crown | 38 mm |
| Case thickness | 9 mm |
| Lug-to-lug length | 46 mm |
| Strap width at lugs | 20 mm |

## Watch identity
- Case material: stainless steel
- Bezel: polished, smooth and circular
- Case flank: horizontal brushed grain
- Lugs: four, gently downturned, brushed upper surfaces
- Crown: one grooved steel crown at 3 o'clock, plain end face
- Dial: matte ivory, #E8E2D6
- Hour markers: 11 single applied steel batons and one double baton at 12
- Minute track: 60 fine black ticks
- Hour and minute hands: polished dauphine hands
- Hand position: 10:10
- Seconds hand: slender blue hand pointing at 6
- Dial inscription: MANUAL, centered above the 6 o'clock marker
- Strap: smooth charcoal leather, #202020, straight cut edges and tonal stitching
- Buckle: rectangular brushed steel pin buckle with softly rounded corners and one central tang

## Photography
| Parameter | Value |
|---|---|
| Sweep | Matte #D8D3CA |
| Key color temperature | 5600 K |
| Key direction | Camera upper left |
| Key elevation | 45 degrees |
| Fill intensity | One quarter of key intensity |
| Black flags | 2, one on either side of the watch |
| Macro reproduction | 1:1 |
| Macro aperture | f/8 |
| Frames per macro focus stack | 12 |
| Hero case height including lugs | At least 80% of image height |

## Editorial copy
| Placement | Exact wording |
|---|---|
| Series name | INDEX 38 |
| Headline | Light reveals the finish |
| Hero caption | 38 mm steel case |
| Dial caption | Hands set to 10:10 |
| Material caption | Polished bezel, brushed flank |

## Editorial page
- Physical size: A4, 210 × 297 mm
- Reading order: square hero, dial macro, material macro

# INDEX 38 — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | hero-square | Square whole-watch hero | 6 | Format: PNG, 1080 by 1080 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 2 | hero-portrait | Portrait whole-watch hero | 6 | Format: PNG, 1600 by 2400 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 3 | dial-macro | Dial and hand assembly macro | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | material-macro | Crown and steel finish macro | 6 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | tabletop-scene | Watch and strap tabletop scene | 6 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | editorial-page | A4 watch editorial page | 6 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
INDEX 38 | Watch macro photography and reflection control

We are commissioning a six-image feature for INDEX 38, our watch editorial series. The subject is one hand-wound wristwatch: a 38 mm stainless steel case excluding the crown, 9 mm thick, with a 46 mm lug-to-lug length and 20 mm strap width. Its polished bezel meets a horizontally brushed case flank; the strap is smooth charcoal leather, #202020, with a brushed steel pin buckle. The three identity images establish the same watch from the front, crown side and buckle side.

The matte ivory dial, #E8E2D6, has 11 single applied steel hour batons, a double baton at 12 and 60 fine black minute ticks. Two polished dauphine hands indicate 10:10, with a slender blue seconds hand pointing at 6. The dial carries "MANUAL" above the 6 o'clock marker. Photograph the series on a matte #D8D3CA sweep with a 5600 K key from camera upper left, elevated 45 degrees, and fill at one quarter of the key's intensity. Use the two black flags in the lighting diagram to define the polished edges. The two macro photographs use 1:1 reproduction, f/8 and 12-frame focus stacks. The editorial page carries "INDEX 38" and the headline "Light reveals the finish".

Audience: watch editors and collectors, for selecting feature photography and examining the watch's dial construction, steel finishes and strap hardware.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the watch specifications, lighting values and editorial wording. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md records the six deliverables and their proportions, formats and stages. watch-geometry-and-lighting.png supplies the measured watch envelope, macro settings and lighting arrangement. watch-front-identity.png establishes the dial, hands, markers and frontal case shape. watch-side-identity.png establishes the crown, bezel profile, brushed flank and lug shape. watch-buckle-identity.png establishes the leather strap and pin buckle. empty-still-life-table.png provides the empty tabletop, sweep and light atmosphere.

Deliverables:
1. Two whole-watch hero images from one frontal exposure, one square crop and one portrait crop, each showing the complete case and both lug pairs
2. One dial macro photograph showing the double 12 o'clock baton, central hand assembly and adjacent minute ticks
3. One material macro photograph showing the crown, polished bezel, brushed case flank and upper crown-side lug
4. One tabletop scene photograph showing the complete watch, its loosely curved leather strap and visible pin buckle
5. One A4 editorial page combining the square hero, dial macro and material macro in that reading order, with the series name, headline and three captions

Acceptance:
- Both whole-watch heroes use the same frontal exposure; the case including its lugs occupies at least 80% of image height in each crop, and both crops contain the complete bezel, crown and four lugs.
- Both whole-watch heroes and the tabletop scene preserve the front identity's 11 single batons, double baton at 12, 60 minute ticks, 10:10 hand position, seconds hand at 6 and MANUAL dial text; the dial macro preserves the same arrangement within its crop.
- The material macro and tabletop scene retain the side identity's polished bezel, horizontally brushed flank and single crown at 3 o'clock; the scene also shows the buckle identity's charcoal leather strap and brushed steel pin buckle.
- Both macro photographs use 1:1 reproduction, f/8 and 12-frame focus stacks. The dial macro resolves the two separate 12 o'clock batons and minute ticks; the material macro resolves the brushed grain, bezel boundary and crown grooves.
- Both heroes, both macros and the tabletop scene use the #D8D3CA sweep and the specified 5600 K upper-left key at 45 degrees, quarter-intensity fill and two black flags; their reflections leave the visible dial marks and the polished-to-brushed boundary legible.
- The A4 editorial page prints INDEX 38 and Light reveals the finish, reuses the three named photographs in hero–dial–material order, and pairs them respectively with these exact captions: "38 mm steel case", "Hands set to 10:10" and "Polished bezel, brushed flank".

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
